retrieval_accuracy.title: Retrieval accuracy by transformation (SHA-256 + pHash)
retrieval_accuracy.description: Gallery of 60 registered originals. For every transformed query: Precision@1 = correct top-1 among queries returning a candidate; Recall@1/Recall@5 = true source within the top-1/top-5 candidates (Hamming ≤ 10); SHA-256 exact = byte-identical lookup. FPR = unrelated negative queries returning any candidate. Measured FPR on 60 negatives: 0.0.

threshold_sweep.title: Hamming threshold sweep (ROC)
threshold_sweep.description: True-positive rate (correct top-1 within threshold, all transformed queries) and false-positive rate (negatives with any candidate within threshold) as the pHash Hamming threshold τ varies.

charts.title: TPR by transformation family vs threshold

cropping_resilience.title: Cropping resilience: pHash vs pHash + ORB/RANSAC
cropping_resilience.description: Recall@1 on crop queries with pHash alone (τ=10) versus pHash plus ORB geometric verification of the top-10 pHash neighbours (accept if RANSAC inliers ≥ 15). FPR measured on negatives.

charts.title: RANSAC inliers: true source vs wrong candidates (crop queries)

crypto_latency.title: Cryptographic primitive latency
crypto_latency.description: Wall-clock latency (µs) of SHA-256 over evidence-sized inputs, RFC 8785-style canonical JSON, Ed25519 (PyNaCl/libsodium) sign + verify of a custody event, RFC 9162 leaf hashing, and witness evaluation of one checkpoint. Single-threaded on the benchmark host; absolute numbers are machine-dependent.

merkle_scaling.title: RFC 9162 Merkle log scaling
merkle_scaling.description: Root computation, inclusion-proof generation/verification and consistency-proof generation/verification (n/2 → n) as the log grows. Proof length grows as ⌈log2 n⌉; verification stays in the microsecond range. Generation here recomputes subtree hashes from leaves (no cached interior nodes).

charts.title: Proof generation time vs tree size
Proof verification time vs tree size

witness_detection.title: Witness rollback / equivocation detection
witness_detection.description: Randomised trials against the production witness decision logic. Each trial: the witness has accepted an honest checkpoint of size m; the (malicious) log then submits a checkpoint of size n. Attacks: rollback (n < m), same-size split view, forked history (an earlier entry rewritten, proof generated honestly from the forked tree), fork + replayed honest proof, and a checkpoint signed by an attacker key. Honest growth trials measure the false-alarm rate.

ablation.title: Ablation: (A) SHA-256 → (B) +pHash → (C) +ORB → (D) full TrustChain + MediaTrace
ablation.description: All transformed queries + negatives. 10% of registered originals are tampered in storage after registration (one byte flipped) to measure silent-corruption exposure. Recovery = correct top-1 candidate. Configurations A–C cannot tell a tampered original from a good one; D runs full cryptographic verification (storage SHA-256, Ed25519 event signature, RFC 9162 inclusion, checkpoint signature, witness co-signature) on the recovered record. Latency excludes one-off ORB feature extraction (pre-computed; mean 1.6 ms per image) and pHash computation, and includes candidate ranking, ORB matching and (D) verification.

metadata_stripping.title: Metadata stripping: SHA-256 vs pHash
metadata_stripping.description: Each registered original (JPEG with EXIF) is stripped of EXIF/XMP/C2PA/IPTC APP segments at the byte level (pixels untouched), stripped + re-encoded (Q95), and stripped + converted to PNG. Measures whether SHA-256 still matches, EXIF survival, and pHash distance to the original. Note: the synthetic originals carry EXIF but no C2PA manifest (embedding one requires a signing certificate); APP11 (C2PA/JUMBF) removal is exercised by the same stripping code path.
